property_profile.name: contract_validation_bounded_v1
property_profile.construction: Build segments directly from the explicit alphabet; distinct source/destination names use disjoint first characters a/b and at most 11 following characters. Never assume/filter, suppress health checks, retry for green or recompute expectations through production helpers.

properties.oracle: A URI produced for each real relative path identifies that same file and immutable authored byte payload; distinct a/b paths remain distinct, including percent and Unicode. Compare to separately retained original Path and bytes; never production roundtrip output as expected.

Copy the identical complete declared tree to the second named root; relative destinations and selected exact const/instance values are unchanged, while the canonical absolute URI carries the second root.

For a stable real binary file of N bytes, returned content equals independent input bytes, payload length N, one unique file, EOF observed, and sum of requested reads N+1. Repeating retrieval in the invocation creates no new read charge.
